skill.name: gws-docs
skill.description: Use the gws CLI to discover, read, create, and update Google Docs through documented Docs API methods.
skill.summary: Manage Google Docs from an AI-assisted gws CLI workflow.
skill.author: googleworkspace

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally uses the external gws CLI to inspect and operate on Google Docs, including commands that can read or write documents with user credentials. Most static hits are Markdown backtick false positives, but the relative references to sibling skill files create an audit-boundary risk because behavior depends on content outside this package.

remediation.issue: External gws commands can read or modify Google Docs.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before write operations and document the Google Workspace scopes needed for each workflow.

remediation.issue: The skill references sibling skill files outside this audited package.
remediation.suggestion: Package the shared and helper instructions with this skill or declare them as audited dependencies without relative parent paths.

remediation.issue: The setup note tells agents to run gws generate-skills if shared instructions are missing.
remediation.suggestion: Ask users to run setup manually and review generated files before the agent loads or follows them.

content.value_statement: Google Docs tasks often require manual API lookup and repetitive CLI setup. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through gws document commands.
actual_capabilities: Run gws docs commands for Google Docs resources and methods.
Inspect Google Docs command options with gws docs help output.
Inspect method parameters with gws schema for Docs methods.
Create blank Google Docs documents through the documents.create method.
Get the latest version of a specified document.
Apply document updates with documents.batchUpdate when valid parameters are supplied.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and Google Workspace authentication from shared setup.
Depends on user permissions for each Google Docs file.
Only documents methods listed in the skill are described directly.
Does not replace review of generated batch update parameters.

use_cases.title: Create Team Documents
use_cases.description: Create shared planning or process documents from a CLI-driven workflow.

use_cases.title: Inspect Docs API Methods
use_cases.description: Review method schemas before automating Google Docs changes.

use_cases.title: Update Existing Drafts
use_cases.description: Retrieve document content and append structured updates inside an AI coding session.

prompt_templates.title: List Available Commands
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the gws-docs skill to show available Google Docs resources and methods. Start with the help command.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a Method
prompt_templates.prompt: Use gws schema to inspect docs.documents.get. Explain required parameters in plain language before running anything.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Blank Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new Google Doc titled "Project Notes" using the documents.create method. Confirm the parameters before calling gws.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Batch Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a documents.batchUpdate request plan for adding a heading and paragraph to an existing document. Show the method schema and validation considerations first.

output_examples.input: Create a blank planning document for the launch team.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks the create method, asks for a title if needed, runs the confirmed command, and returns the new document details.

output_examples.input: Get the latest version of a specific Google Doc.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies the get method, confirms the document identifier, retrieves the document, and summarizes the returned structure.

output_examples.input: Append a short status note to a shared document.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms the target document and text, uses the append helper, and reports whether the update succeeded.

best_practices: Confirm the document identifier and requested method before any write operation.
Use gws schema before building parameters for create or batchUpdate.
Keep Google Workspace credentials scoped to the documents you intend to manage.
anti_patterns: Running write or batch update commands before reviewing the target document.
Pasting sensitive document content into prompts without a clear business need.
Assuming the skill can bypass Google Docs permissions or approval flows.

faq.question: Does this skill require Google authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. It relies on the gws CLI and the shared Google Workspace authentication setup.

faq.question: Can it create Google Docs?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents the documents.create method for creating blank documents with a title.

faq.question: Can it edit existing documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes documents.batchUpdate and links to a helper for appending text.

faq.question: Can it read any Google Doc?
faq.answer: No. Access depends on the credentials and permissions available to the gws CLI.

faq.question: Does it manage credentials directly?
faq.answer: No. Credential setup is delegated to the shared Google Workspace instructions and the gws CLI.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
